rebuild_intent.summary: A symmetrical, multi-tiered Asian-inspired pagoda structure with a rectangular footprint. The building features stacked horizontal roof overhangs in dark material, a central body constructed from wood and stonebrick, decorative gold/brass corner supports, and a central entrance passage. The structure sits on a raised dirt foundation surrounded by grass.
